subject: Charged twice for Starter plan
body: I just noticed my card was charged $9 twice this month for my Starter subscription. Can you refund the duplicate charge?

resolution.reason: Duplicate billing error, refund amount under $20 auto-approval threshold.

subject: Want refund on annual Business upgrade
body: I upgraded to the annual Business plan 5 days ago and changed my mind. I'd like a full refund of the $790 charge.

resolution.reason: Refund amount exceeds $20 auto-approval threshold and involves an annual contract; escalated to human support lead who approved the refund.

subject: Still billed at old rate after downgrading
body: I downgraded from Pro to Starter last week but my card was just charged the Pro rate again. Is this a mistake?

resolution.reason: Downgrades take effect at the start of the next billing period per policy; customer was billed correctly, no refund owed.

subject: Threatening chargeback over unrecognized charge
body: There's a $29 charge on my card I don't recognize. If this isn't sorted out today I'm filing a chargeback with my bank.

resolution.reason: Customer mentioned intent to file a chargeback; escalated to Finance per policy rather than processing a standard refund.

subject: New card declined, need to update payment method
body: My new card keeps getting declined when I try to update my payment info. How do I fix this?

resolution.reason: Pointed customer to Settings > Billing > Payment Methods self-serve flow.

subject: Early cancellation of annual Pro, wants prorated refund
body: I've been on the annual Pro plan for 3 months and want to cancel now. Can I get a prorated refund for the remaining months?

resolution.reason: Any refund request involving an annual contract is escalated regardless of amount; human lead calculated the prorated refund minus the 10% early-cancellation fee.

subject: Enterprise onboarding was botched, wants a refund
body: Our Enterprise onboarding this month was a disaster and we'd like a partial refund for the month.

resolution.reason: Enterprise refund requests are always routed to the customer's dedicated account manager, never handled by general support.

subject: Double charged for Starter plan again
body: This is the second time this has happened - charged $9 twice in one billing cycle for Starter. Please refund the extra charge.

resolution.reason: Duplicate billing error, refund amount under $20 auto-approval threshold.

subject: Forgot password, need reset link
body: I can't remember my password and the reset email isn't arriving. Can you send it to the email on my account?

resolution.reason: Email on file matched the account, low-risk auto-approved action.

subject: Wants 2FA turned off to log back in
body: I'm locked out because I lost my 2FA device. Can you just disable 2FA on my account so I can get back in?

resolution.reason: 2FA can never be disabled by a support agent; escalated to Security team for identity verification.

subject: Locked out after failed logins
body: I got locked out after typing my password wrong a few times. Can you unlock my account? I've verified my email is on file.

resolution.reason: Identity verified via email on file, auto-approved unlock.

subject: Team member requesting ownership transfer
body: I'm a team member on the Acme account and I'd like to be made the account owner instead of our current owner.

resolution.reason: Requester's email is not on file as the account owner; escalated rather than acted on directly.

subject: Wants a copy of all their data
body: Before I decide whether to keep my subscription, I'd like a full export of my data.

resolution.reason: Pointed customer to the self-serve Settings > Export flow.

subject: Demanding immediate account and data deletion
body: Delete my account and all my data right now, this is a GDPR request and I want it done today.

resolution.reason: Account/data deletion is irreversible and always routed to Compliance team, regardless of urgency expressed by the customer.

subject: Removing a departed employee's seat
body: One of our team members left the company, how do I remove their seat so we're not paying for it?

resolution.reason: Self-serve action via Settings > Team > Remove Member, low risk.

subject: Unrecognized login from new location
body: I got an alert about a login from a country I've never been to. I'm worried my account has been compromised.

resolution.reason: Suspected account compromise, escalated to Security rather than treated as a routine account question.

subject: Export button slightly misaligned on Safari
body: Small visual issue: the 'export to PDF' button overlaps the title a bit when I use Safari. Not urgent.

resolution.reason: Cosmetic issue affecting one user, logged only, no escalation needed.

subject: Automations stopped firing after update
body: My automation rules stopped triggering after the last product update. Is there a workaround while this gets fixed?

resolution.reason: Known workaround (recreate the automation rule) exists; logged to engineering backlog, workaround shared with customer.

subject: Entire project board disappeared
body: A project board with 3 months of our team's work just vanished. We need this back immediately.

resolution.reason: Potential data loss, escalated to engineering immediately, never auto-closed.

subject: SSO broken for entire organization
body: Nobody on our team can log in this morning, SSO is throwing an error for everyone in our Business org.

resolution.reason: Feature completely broken for a whole team, escalated to engineering within SLA window.

subject: Boards loading slowly, only for me
body: My boards have been taking 10+ seconds to load the past two days, but my teammates say it's fine for them.

resolution.reason: Not enough detail to classify severity (single user, unclear cause); asked for browser/OS and network details before escalating.

subject: Custom API rate limit not being honored
body: Our Enterprise account has a custom rate limit configured but we're still getting 429 errors well below that threshold.

resolution.reason: Enterprise custom configuration issue beyond generic troubleshooting, escalated to engineering.

subject: Mobile app crashing on launch for multiple users
body: Several people on our Business team have had the mobile app crash immediately on launch since the latest update.

resolution.reason: Multiple users affected on one org, escalated to engineering.

subject: Typo in reminder email
body: Small thing, but the reminder email says 'recieve' instead of 'receive'.

resolution.reason: Cosmetic, low impact, logged only.

subject: How do I invite my team?
body: New to Flowbase, how do I invite the rest of my team to our workspace?

resolution.reason: Answered directly from FAQ, Settings > Team > Invite by email.

subject: What's the API rate limit on Pro?
body: Quick question - does the API have a rate limit on the Pro plan?

resolution.reason: Answered directly from FAQ: 1000 requests/hour on Pro.

subject: Is there a permanent free plan?
body: Can I keep using Flowbase for free forever if I don't need many features?

resolution.reason: Answered directly from FAQ: no permanent free tier, only the 14-day Pro trial.

subject: Loving the new dashboard
body: Just wanted to say the new dashboard redesign is great, nice work team!

resolution.reason: Positive feedback, no action needed, thanked the customer and closed.

subject: Feature request: dark mode
body: Any plans to add a dark mode? Would love to see that added.

resolution.reason: Logged as a feature request, thanked customer, not urgent or bug-related so no escalation.

subject: Asking about SLA credit after outage
body: We had downtime last week on our Business plan. Do we qualify for a service credit?

resolution.reason: SLA credit calculations require incident data outside the support system, always escalated to a human.

subject: my team no see task fast fix
body: hi pls help my team cannot see task on board fast fix thanks

resolution.reason: Too ambiguous to act on (could be permissions, sync, or bug); asked a clarifying question rather than guessing or escalating prematurely.

subject: Unrelated marketing email sent to support
body: Hi, we'd love to offer your company a bulk discount on office furniture, let us know if interested!

resolution.reason: Not a genuine support request, closed as spam/not applicable, no action needed.
